261371|c0c247fc.name: Vrang Wildgore
261371|c0c247fc.text:
Those humans got what they deserved. 

<Vrang spits on the ground.>

3430|71e13f0e.name: Mangletooth
3430|71e13f0e.text:
My hatred is strong <snort>, but the time is right to tell you a tale, $r.

Long ago a battle took place between gods. Agamaggan, our great boar god, fell to the earth after being defeated in the War of the Ancients, his blood raining down and his bones torn asunder. <snort>

Great thorns reached up out of the earth where his blood touched the ground, and his skull adorns one of the caverns to the south.

5042-progress.name: Mangletooth
5042-progress.text:
I will need 4 blood shards if you wish Agamaggan's strength, $r.

Your foes will cower before your strength were you to be given this blessing. <snort>

The Razormane's greatest warriors are infused with such power!
5042-progress.title: Agamaggan's Strength

5043-progress.name: Mangletooth
5043-progress.text:
My tribes greatest scouts are said to be unrivaled in their accuracy, and no rogue <snort> could measure up to their quickness in battle.

Bring me 4 blood shards and I will make you even more agile than any quilboar born.
5043-progress.title: Agamaggan's Agility

5044-progress.name: Mangletooth
5044-progress.text:
The shaman and geomancers of the quilboar tribes <snort> call upon the strength of Agamaggan to help them in battle and in their rituals, $r.

If you too wish the added power of Agamaggan's blessing with your spells, then bring me 4 blood shards and Mangletooth will aid you. <snort>
5044-progress.title: Wisdom of Agamaggan

5045-progress.name: Mangletooth
5045-progress.text:
Warriors of all types <snort> have need of a strong spirit. It drives you to greater feats when all hope has been lost. This is not unknown to the <snort> Razormane. We are a spiritual tribe--we are more proud of our connection to Agamaggan than our prowess <snort> in battle.

Bring me 4 blood shards and I will bless your spirit for battle. <snort>
5045-progress.title: Rising Spirit

5046-progress.name: Mangletooth
5046-progress.text:
All those who <snort> enter battle have need of protection. Their bones must be strong. Their skin tough. <snort> My tribe knows this as well, and to add to the natural protection our quills and hide give us, <snort> we often call upon Agamaggan to protect us from harm before we go to war.

Bring me 4 blood shards <snort> and I will grant you the same protection.
5046-progress.title: Razorhide

5052-progress.name: Mangletooth
5052-progress.text:
Our tribes flock to the thorny areas throughout the Barrens <snort> because they are holy places, but none as holy as Razorfen. Agamaggan's body makes up the entirety of the Razorfen, <snort> but the Downs are especially protected because the entrance is made from his great maw! <snort> It will swallow whole those not loyal to him, and spit out their bodies after he's chewed them up! <snort>

Agamaggan has left his body behind to protect us, and he gives of his spirit so we may protect him. <snort>
5052-progress.title: Blood Shards of Agamaggan

7813-progress.name: Ralston Farnsley
7813-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Undercity for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7813-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

79097-progress.name: Owen Thadd
79097-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79097-progress.title: Baxtan: On Destructive Magics

876-progress.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
876-progress.text: You're not getting anything until I see Serena's head.
876-progress.title: Serena Bloodfeather

889-progress.name: Mangletooth
889-progress.text:
Bring Mangletooth 10 blood shards and I will bless you with great speed. You will run with zhevra and the wind will be jealous of you.

It will not last long, but it should be enough to help you travel throughout the Barrens.
889-progress.title: Spirit of the Wind

899-progress.name: Mankrik
899-progress.text: The quilboar will pay for this, $N. I swear it.
899-progress.title: Consumed by Hatred

92421-accept.name: Morbin Lightbane
92421-accept.text:
As a paladin of the Forsaken, it is my duty to exact the will of our Dark Lady while tending to our people's needs. We are fortunate with an opportunity to accomplish both.

Above the Undercity, the scourge still roam unchecked in great numbers. Our forces dwindle trying to reclaim our land, and decaying flesh cannot be reknit. Not without replacements.

Would that our glorious captain Garek Bandarion still be with us, I know what he would wish. To finish what he started and heal our kin. For Lordaeron!
92421-accept.title: Light's Justice

95216-accept.name: Theodore Griffs
95216-accept.text:
Welcome to the most vital organ of the Undercity: The Apothecarium! Here we experiment on the most virulent of Azeroth's exotic specimens.

You've caught me in a good mood, so I will let you in on my latest investigation. It appears there is a particularly venomous arthropod stalking the ruins above our fair city. Its toxins are said to eat through even undead flesh. How exhilarating!

I wish to validate these claims. Should you find yourself withering away from its bite, I should love a sample.
95216-accept.title: The New Plague

95508-complete.name: Walton
95508-complete.text:
Well, looks like we are all alive. I... knew that someday that would catch up to me. I'm in your debt for your help here today.

Please, take this. It's not much, but it's the least I can do.

Safe travels, $c.
95508-complete.title: Unwelcome Guests

95621-progress.name: Walton
95621-progress.text:
The remnants of Daelin Proudmoore's fleet who still fly his banner are just as rotten and barbaric as the admiral himself was before he died.

I don't know why they are so far from Tiragarde, but it can't be good.
95621-progress.title: Trouble in the Valley

95774-complete.name: Mankrik
95774-complete.text:
I will place these adornments with my wife's memorial, so that I never forget her. My blood will always run hot with revenge!

You have done me... done us... a great favor, $N.
95774-complete.title: Her Name Is Olgra

95774-progress.name: Mankrik
95774-progress.text: I have only memories now, but I will build a tribute to Olgra so that they never fade.
95774-progress.title: Her Name Is Olgra
